snippet.title: FINAL FURY Date Reveal Trailer feat. Justin Wong | Meta Quest 2 + Meta Quest 3 + SteamVR
snippet.description:
🥊Wishlist NOW🥊
➡️Meta Quest: https://www.meta.com/experiences/final-fury/5218982198148896/
➡️Steam VR: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1782760/FINAL_FURY/

The ultimate VR fighting game inspired by arcade classics launches into Early Access on May 8th! 

Face off against the galaxy’s fiercest fighters—offline or across the world in multiplayer with rollback netcode. Every punch, every block, every special attack is powered by hand gestures and YOUR movement. 

To show its love of fighting games, the team enlisted competitive fighting legend and nine-time EVO champion, Justin Wong. With Justin’s advice, FINAL FURY’s pacing, mechanics, and overall feel have been refined to hit all the right notes for fighting game purists and first-time combatants alike.

“​When the team at Kluge Interactive first approached me about FINAL FURY, I was intrigued by their vision of integrating classic fighting game mechanics into a first-person VR experience. After playing and providing feedback on elements like dashes, grabs, and character play styles, I'm excited to see how players will engage with the game when it releases into Early Access.” - Justin Wong

Join the Discord community to help shape the future of FINAL FURY today: https://discord.gg/finalfury

Original soundtrack composed by @djzardonic 
--------------------------------
